synopsis: The forced deadline produced honest unavailable outcomes everywhere except the lake debrief, which Gemini served. That debrief got the core lesson (relocation blocked, medication continuity next) but misdescribed the timing of the family's choice, added an unsupported shelter-in-place safety framing, inferred a specific medication from an internal ID, and answered in Vietnamese although English was selected. Both Gemini director restarts failed schema validation twice (initial plus repair). The restart mechanism itself appears to work as designed by source inspection, but the capture cannot prove what the provider saw.

fact_findings.finding: Timing misdescribed by the Gemini summary.
Medication identity inferred from the ID token; Codex and the prompt's no-internal-ID rule avoid this.
Gemini followed the household preference instead of the selected locale.

fact_ids: restartHistory output contains no function_result steps
fact_findings.finding: Gemini receives structured-output enforcement only when no tools are offered or history contains a function_result. After a restart the abandoned results become a user input, and the director always offers tools, so the Gemini director finalization runs without the response schema and with tool_choice defaulting to any.

likely_stage: Gemini director schema_mismatch: provider adapter. In provider.ts the Gemini request sets response_format only when tools are empty or the history contains a function_result; restartHistory removes function_result steps (turning them into a hostRetrievedRecords user input) and the gateway still offers director tools, so the restarted Gemini finalization is unconstrained JSON and fails directorOutput twice. A second contributor is that job state keeps toolUsed and previewCommands from the Codex preview, so the FINALIZATION instruction requires Gemini to echo commands from a preview it did not make, while it sees that preview only as a host note. Lake debrief defects: model/prompt (Gemini) plus no host check that output language matches context.locale and no check against medication names absent from family-facing records.

recommendations: Gemini adapter: decide response_format from an explicit finalization flag (no tools offered, or job toolUsed) rather than from history step types; or have restartHistory emit a host-labelled synthetic function_call/function_result pair for director previews so existing gates apply.

Director restart: either reset toolUsed/previewCommands so the fallback runs its own preview, or present the Codex preview to the fallback as the authoritative preview with its exact commands and let the gateway attach them, instead of asking the model to echo them.

Prompt (all feature roles): write in context.locale; household preferredLocale and communication notes never change the output language. Gateway: add a cheap script/language check against context.locale with one repair.
Debrief validator: reject medication or device names that appear only in internal IDs; refer to recorded purpose or label.

Harness: capture, in the protected bundle only, the provider-bound message role/step-type sequence and byte sizes per attempt plus Zod issue paths, so restart isolation and schema failures are verifiable.
retests: Repeat the forced deadline 3x for freeze and fire after the adapter change: pass if Gemini returns valid proposals 3/3 or truthful unavailable with a non-schema cause.
Repeat lake debrief forced to Gemini 3x: pass if English 3/3 and timing matches the receipt 3/3.
Protected capture assertion: restarted provider input contains no function_call steps and exactly one hostRetrievedRecords input.
